description: Source code for Elasticsearch client configuration and creation functions in the Mattermost server, including handling TLS, CA, and client certificates.

methods.name: createTypedClient
methods.description: Creates a typed Elasticsearch client with configuration and error handling.

methods.name: createUntypedClient
methods.description: Creates an untyped Elasticsearch client with configuration and error handling.

methods.name: createClientConfig
methods.description: Builds Elasticsearch client configuration including TLS, CA, and authentication settings.

methods.name: configureCA
methods.description: Reads and sets the CA certificate for Elasticsearch client configuration.

methods.name: configureClientCertificate
methods.description: Reads client certificate and key files, and updates TLS configuration.
